# G2

> G2 is a leading B2B software marketplace and review platform providing buyer intent data, product reviews, and marketplace licensing across 1700+ software categories.

G2 offers comprehensive documentation and partner resources for integrating with its marketplace, accessing buyer intent signals, and leveraging product licensing data. The platform serves both software buyers seeking authentic reviews and vendors looking to reach enterprise customers.

## Key Topics

- Buyer Intent
- G2 Categories
- Product Licensing
- Marketplace Data
- Integration
- Review Campaigns
- Seller Onboarding
- Product Profile
- Category Taxonomy
- Scoring Methodology
- Flow Builder
- G2 MCP Server
- Partner Program
- Product Catalog
- Data Licensing

## Documentation & Integration

- [G2 Documentation Hub](https://documentation.g2.com/): Complete documentation covering integrations, buyer intent data, and platform features for developers and partners

## Product Licensing & Marketplace

- [G2 Categories](https://partner.g2.com/categories): Product licensing solution providing access to marketplace data across 1700+ software categories with comprehensive category taxonomy
